questions.question: [Technical] You created Excel spreadsheets and PowerPoint presentations to support maintenance decisions. Walk us through one analysis: what data you used, how you structured or validated it, what insight you found, and how it changed a decision.

[Technical] This role requires formal requirements analysis, which is not explicitly described in your background. How would you elicit, document, validate, and obtain sign-off on requirements from business users, technicians, and managers for a mobile-system improvement?

[Behavioural] Describe how you worked with Quality Assurance to maintain compliance with NAMP 4790.2b while supervising 20 aircraft logbooks and five maintenance programs. How did you handle a discrepancy or competing interpretation of the requirements?

[Situational] A mobile application’s operations team requests a workflow change, while management wants a different feature completed first and technical staff identify delivery risk. How would you assess the requests, prioritize them, communicate the rationale, and maintain stakeholder alignment?

[Role-Specific] Your weekly process-improvement training for more than 100 maintenance professionals reduced man-hours and eliminated wasteful practices. What was the underlying process problem, how did you measure the improvement, and how would you adapt that approach to business-process optimization in this role?

[Technical] What experience do you have with user acceptance testing? If asked to lead UAT for a new mobile workflow, how would you create test scenarios, define acceptance criteria, capture defects, and determine readiness for release?

[Behavioural] Tell us about a time you had to influence people to adopt a process change, such as during your process-improvement training. What resistance did you encounter, what did you do, and what was the result?

[Situational] You inherit a business process supported by a legacy system, comparable in complexity to the NALCOMIS/SYBASE environment you supported. How would you decide whether to automate, modernize, or retain the process while controlling operational disruption and cost?

[Cultural/Motivational] What motivates your transition from transportation logistics, manufacturing operations, and naval maintenance records into a Business Analyst role focused on mobile solutions, and how do you plan to build depth in areas such as formal BA documentation and modern IT practices?

[Role-Specific] This position requires managing project plans, deliverables, resources, and deadlines. Drawing on your experience supervising shifts and resolving NALCOMIS issues to minimize downtime, describe how you would establish a project plan and manage risks when several critical deliverables are due at the same time.
